entries.reason: reverseSettlementForVoid() flips driver_settlements to status='cancelled'+voided_at directly (R-102-B). Since LEAD 443.192 (2026-10-17) it runs the shared driver-settlement void cascade completeDriverSettlementVoidCascadeInClientTx (lines voided, open driver bills + unpaid reimbursements released) with voidChildren:false. Since LEAD 443.193 (2026-10-17) driver_settlement_deductions is no longer a CASCADE_CHILDREN entry on ANY path (a raw voided_at stamp forgave an uncollected deduction — 'why would I forgive the debt'); the cascade's step 5 releases the settlement's pending deductions through restoreSettlementDeductionsInClientTx when the GL had nothing to reverse, and the GL reversal restores them when it did. The remaining registered children are settlement_lines (voided by the cascade's own step 1) and dead-by-inheritance tables, so cascadeVoidChildren would stamp nothing more here. Kept in the baseline with this reason, not wired.
